name: Mediastinal Multilesion Detection Benchmark
description: A chest CT benchmark dataset for evaluating detection of multiple mediastinal lesions, particularly assessing size-adaptive detection performance.
evaluation_method: mean Average Precision (mAP) and detection sensitivity / FROC (false positives per scan)
reputation: A specialized clinical benchmark with limited but relevant adoption in medical imaging research focused on mediastinal lesion detection.
notes: Medical-imaging benchmark (non-LLM); likely limited dataset size, class imbalance, and clinical variability — results depend on evaluation protocol (slice vs. volume) and may not generalize without careful validation.
